options.why_wrong: The present perfect continuous looks back from the present. The stem requires a future viewpoint, so 'will have been' is needed.

options.why_wrong: The simple future does not show that the action will be in progress up to the future point and emphasise its duration.

grammar_focus: Future perfect continuous with 'by' plus a future time expression
explanation: The connector 'by' sets a future deadline, so the main clause needs the future perfect continuous: will have been plus the -ing form. This structure stresses that the action will be in progress up to that deadline. Ukrainian speakers often choose a simple future here because Ukrainian expresses this duration with a different verb form and no separate perfect auxiliary, so the will-have-been pattern needs deliberate practice.
